product.description: Matematică, geometrie, fizicăhellip; Arhimede este unul dintre cei mai mari savanți din istorie. Specialitatea lui? Icirc;și verifica teoriile prin experimente. Căuta mijloace de a măsura cu precizie cercurile, sferele, cilindrii; incerca să calculeze numărul boabelor de nisip din univers; studia reflexia luminii și pacirc;rghiile. Arhimede a fost și un inventator extraordinar! Lui i se datorează roata dințată și șurubul fără sfacirc;rșit (care a ajutat la irigarea cacirc;mpurilor și la propulsarea corăbiilor). A organizat apărarea Siracuzei impotriva romanilor și, trei ani la racirc;nd, invențiile lui (precum catapulta) vor apăra cetatea. Superputerile lui au fost pasiunea nemăsurată pentru matematică și dorinţa arzătoare de a o folosi pentru a face viaţa oamenilor mai ușoară. Datorită cunoștinţelor sale a inventat numeroase mecanisme, precum șurubul lui Arhimede, și a descoperit legi fundamentale ale fizicii, cum este legea care-i poartă numele. Iată povestea lui!

# Volum 15: Little Heroes - Archimedes by Litera

## Discover the Genius of Archimedes

Dive into the fascinating world of science and history with *Volum 15. MICII EROI. Arhimede*. This book introduces young readers to Archimedes, one of history's greatest scholars. If your child loves math, physics, and solving incredible puzzles, this narrative-driven biography is a must-read that brings the brilliance of an ancient inventor to life!

## A Journey Through Ancient Science

Archimedes was more than just a mathematician; he was a groundbreaking scientist, engineer, and thinker whose passion for knowledge revolutionized understanding. This book explores his extraordinary career, detailing how he sought to verify theories through rigorous experimentation.

Inside this volume, your child will learn about:

*   **Mathematics & Geometry:** Discovering methods to measure circles, spheres, and cylinders with incredible precision.
*   **Physics Pioneer:** Exploring fundamental laws of physics, including the principle that bears his name (Archimedes' Principle).
*   **Invention Genius:** Learning about his remarkable inventions, such as the sophisticated geared wheel and the lever, which were crucial for everything from farming to war defense.

## The Mind Behind the Myths

The narrative vividly recounts Archimedesâ lifeâfrom organizing the defense of Syracuse against the Romans to designing massive machines like the catapult. His scientific curiosity was boundless; he even attempted to calculate the number of grains of sand in the universe!

This book showcases that his "superpowers" were not magical, but rather an immense, unstoppable passion for mathematics and a fierce desire to use that knowledge to improve human life. Itâs a perfect way to spark an early interest in STEM fields through engaging storytelling.
